summary: The bill amends the National Housing Act to add VA loan details (including prevailing rates) to the Informed Consumer Choice Disclosure given to prospective FHA borrowers and requires the Federal Housing Finance Agency to add a military service question above the signature line on the Uniform Residential Loan Application.
